# rubrik_azure_management_group (Resource)

The `rubrik_azure_management_group` resource onboards the Azure subscriptions of an Azure management group to RSC,
without OAuth. One resource manages the subscriptions onboarded through a single management group in a single tenant,
and the features enabled on them. All the subscriptions get the same features.

RSC signs in as the customer app registered with the `rubrik_azure_service_principal` resource, and creates the role
definitions at the management group scope and the role assignments for each subscription. The app's service principal
must therefore have the `Contributor` and `User Access Administrator` roles at the management group scope. RSC can
only remove its role assignments when these roles are in place, so keep them until the resource is destroyed.

~> **Note:** The RSC feature flag `AZURE_CLOUDACCOUNTS_MANAGEMENT_GROUP_ENABLED` must be enabled for the RSC account.

~> **Note:** A subscription must not be managed by both this resource and the `rubrik_azure_subscription` resource.
Once a subscription has been onboarded through a management group, it can no longer be updated through
`rubrik_azure_subscription`.

## Limitations
  * OAuth onboarding of management groups needs interactive consent in a browser and is not supported.
  * Subscriptions added to the management group later are not onboarded automatically. Add them to
    `subscription_ids`.
  * Changing `regions`, or the `permission_groups` or resource group of an existing `feature`, is not supported. Remove
    the feature and add it again, or create a new resource.
  * Azure Government Cloud is not supported.

Subscriptions and features removed from the configuration are disabled in RSC, the snapshots are kept. When the resource
is destroyed, the snapshots are deleted if `delete_snapshots_on_destroy` is `true`.

## Import
The resource ID is `<tenant_domain>/<management_group_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The app's service principal needs the Contributor and User Access
# Administrator roles at the management group scope. Keep them in place until
# the resource has been destroyed, RSC needs them to remove its role
# assignments.
data "azurerm_management_group" "prod" {
  name = "prod-mg"
}

resource "azurerm_role_assignment" "rsc_contributor" {
  scope                = data.azurerm_management_group.prod.id
  role_definition_name = "Contributor"
  principal_id         = var.rsc_app_object_id
}

resource "azurerm_role_assignment" "rsc_user_access_administrator" {
  scope                = data.azurerm_management_group.prod.id
  role_definition_name = "User Access Administrator"
  principal_id         = var.rsc_app_object_id
}

resource "rubrik_azure_service_principal" "default" {
  app_id        = "25c2b42a-c76b-11eb-9767-6ff6b5b7e72b"
  app_name      = "My App"
  app_secret    = "<my-apps-secret>"
  tenant_domain = "mydomain.onmicrosoft.com"
  tenant_id     = "2bfdaef8-c76b-11eb-8d3d-4706c14a88f0"
}

# Onboard the subscriptions of the management group. Subscriptions added to the
# management group later are not onboarded automatically.
data "rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy" "prod" {
  tenant_domain       = rubrik_azure_service_principal.default.tenant_domain
  app_id              = rubrik_azure_service_principal.default.app_id
  management_group_id = "prod-mg"
  features            = ["CLOUD_NATIVE_PROTECTION"]

  depends_on = [
    azurerm_role_assignment.rsc_contributor,
    azurerm_role_assignment.rsc_user_access_administrator,
  ]
}

resource "rubrik_azure_management_group" "prod" {
  tenant_domain       = rubrik_azure_service_principal.default.tenant_domain
  app_id              = rubrik_azure_service_principal.default.app_id
  management_group_id = "prod-mg"
  regions             = ["eastus2", "westus2"]
  subscription_ids    = data.rubrik_azure_management_group_hierarchy.prod.all_subscription_ids

  feature {
    name              = "CLOUD_NATIVE_PROTECTION"
    permission_groups = ["BASIC", "EXPORT_AND_RESTORE", "FILE_LEVEL_RECOVERY"]
  }

  feature {
    name                  = "CLOUD_NATIVE_ARCHIVAL"
    permission_groups     = ["BASIC"]
    resource_group_name   = "rubrik-archival"
    resource_group_region = "eastus2"
  }
}

# With an explicit list of subscriptions.
resource "rubrik_azure_management_group" "dev" {
  tenant_domain       = rubrik_azure_service_principal.default.tenant_domain
  app_id              = rubrik_azure_service_principal.default.app_id
  management_group_id = "dev-mg"
  regions             = ["eastus2"]
  subscription_ids = [
    "7f3b4c19-5a0d-4c4a-9d0e-2b6f3b8c1a11",
    "0c8d2f6e-91a4-4d7b-b2c5-6a1e9f4d3b22",
  ]

  feature {
    name              = "CLOUD_NATIVE_PROTECTION"
    permission_groups = ["BASIC"]
  }

  delete_snapshots_on_destroy = false
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Azure app registration application ID (UUID) of the customer app, as set with the `rubrik_azure_service_principal` resource. The secret stored in RSC for the app is used. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `management_group_id` (String) Azure management group ID. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `regions` (Set of String) Azure regions to enable the features in. Should be specified in the standard Azure style, e.g. `eastus`. Changing the regions of an existing resource is not supported.
- `subscription_ids` (Set of String) Azure subscription IDs (UUIDs) to onboard. The subscriptions must be in the management group and eligible for the features. Subscriptions removed from the set have their features disabled in RSC.
- `tenant_domain` (String) Azure tenant primary domain. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `delete_snapshots_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the snapshots of the subscriptions when the resource is destroyed. Default value is `false`.
- `feature` (Block Set) RSC features to enable on all the subscriptions. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--feature))

### Read-Only

- `customer_management_group_id` (String) RSC customer management group ID (UUID).
- `id` (String) Resource ID, in the format `<tenant_domain>/<management_group_id>`.
- `management_group_name` (String) Azure management group display name.

<a id="nestedblock--feature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `feature`

Required:

- `name` (String) RSC feature name. Possible values are `AZURE_POSTGRES_FLEXIBLE_SERVER_PROTECTION`, `AZURE_SQL_DB_PROTECTION`, `AZURE_SQL_MI_PROTECTION`, `CLOUD_DISCOVERY`, `CLOUD_NATIVE_ARCHIVAL`, `CLOUD_NATIVE_ARCHIVAL_ENCRYPTION`, `CLOUD_NATIVE_BLOB_PROTECTION`, `CLOUD_NATIVE_PROTECTION`, `CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT`, `EXOCOMPUTE` and `SERVERS_AND_APPS`.
- `permission_groups` (Set of String) Permission groups for the RSC feature. At least one is required.

Optional:

- `resource_group_name` (String) Name of the Azure resource group RSC creates the feature's resources in. Required for the `CLOUD_NATIVE_ARCHIVAL` feature, ignored for other features.
- `resource_group_region` (String) Region of the Azure resource group, e.g. `eastus`.
- `resource_group_tags` (Map of String) Tags to add to the Azure resource group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = rubrik_azure_management_group.prod
  identity = {
    id = "mydomain.onmicrosoft.com/prod-mg"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Resource ID, in the format `<tenant_domain>/<management_group_id>`.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = rubrik_azure_management_group.prod
  id = "mydomain.onmicrosoft.com/prod-mg"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
% terraform import rubrik_azure_management_group.prod mydomain.onmicrosoft.com/prod-mg
```
